notablePrerequisites: You control at least five additional creatures with haste.
description:
Declare Ognis and five other creatures with haste as attackers.
Ognis triggers six times.
Resolve the first Ognis trigger, creating a tapped Treasure token.
The Treasure enters the battlefield, triggering Amulet of Vigor, untapping the Treasure.
Repeat from step 3 for each remaining trigger.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate five Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.
